raw_yaml:
server:
    listen: :18080
    read_timeout_ms: 30000
    write_timeout_ms: 0
    idle_timeout_ms: 120000
    max_body_bytes: 104857600
admin:
    enabled: true
    bootstrap_token: local-admin-bootstrap-token-32-characters-minimum
    cookie_signing_key: local-cookie-signing-key-32-characters-min
    publish_history_limit: 256
    tokens:
        - name: admin
          token: local-admin-token-ai-model-gateway
          role: admin
        - name: viewer
          token: local-viewer-token-ai-model-gateway
          role: viewer
    language: zh
    rate_limit:
        requests_per_second: 10
        burst: 20
routing:
    strategy: health_weighted_rr
    max_retries: 2
    retry_backoff:
        initial_ms: 3000
        max_ms: 60000
    health:
        enabled: true
        interval_sec: 30
        timeout_ms: 5000
        path: /v1/models
    sticky_sessions:
        enabled: true
        ttl_sec: 1800
    failure_policy:
        threshold: 20
        cooldown_sec: 60
        passthrough_after_sec: 600
        quota_recovery_interval_min: 0
        disable_cooldown: false
    retry:
        infinite_on_error: true
        all_errors: false
        status_codes:
            - 408
            - 429
        status_code_min: 500
        message_keywords:
            - too many requests
            - rate limit
            - quota exceeded
            - stream disconnected before completion
            - stream closed before response.completed
            - upstream request failed
            - server busy
            - system busy
            - temporarily unavailable
            - temporarily overloaded
            - overloaded
            - please try again later
            - service unavailable
    intercepts: []
    rate_limit:
        enabled: false
        requests_per_second: 0
        burst: 0
    cache:
        enabled: false
        max_entries: 1000
        ttl_seconds: 300
    key_rotation:
        enabled: false
    queue:
        max_concurrent: 100
        high_priority_pct: 60
    compression:
        level: 5
        min_size_bytes: 1024

telemetry:
    sqlite_path: configs\data\telemetry.db
    retention_days: 30
    aggregation_sec: 60
    cache_ttl_sec: 5

    refresh_interval_minutes: 720
    request_timeout_ms: 15000

        - id: moonshot

        - id: minimax

        - id: deepseek

        - id: xai

        - id: step

benchmarking:
    enabled: false
    default_suite: general_protocol_v1
    judge:
        public_model: gpt-5.5
        provider: nowcoding
        timeout_ms: 30000
    limits:
        max_parallel_runs: 1
        max_parallel_cases: 2
        per_case_timeout_ms: 30000
    verdict_thresholds:
        normal_max_gap: 8
        suspect_max_gap: 20
        high_suspect_protocol_failures: 2
    aliases: []
compat:
    bridge:
        enabled: true
        rules:
            - from: gpt-5.4-mini
              to: deepseek-v4-flash
        exclude_user_agents: []
    fallback:
        enabled: false
        detect_repetition: false
        models: {}
